messages:
maria (AE): Heads-up — Sparrow Med CFO wants a risk + pricing summary for tomorrow's call. Legal still needs KMS attestation and egress plan. Can @sam (SE) and @raj (Infra) update status? @olivia (SE) FYI on pricing.

sam (SE): Working on the attestation doc now. Two quick clarifications: are they BYO KMS or do we expect to offer Redwood-managed keys? If BYO, we need the exact Key URI and an IP allowlist for the peering.

jen (Legal): Also need a short data flow diagram and retention policy to attach to the addendum. If someone can drop a one-pager I can loop in procurement counsel.

tariq (Solutions): Sparrow requires outbound egress to their analytics VPC (10.2.16.0/20) over TLS with mTLS client certs. We submitted a peering request but network approval is pending. ETA from network team is ~48-72 hrs.

olivia (SE): On pricing: customer asked for a carve-out — 12% discount on hosted usage + reserved Dedicated nodes. CFO is asking if we can give an extra 3% for a 2.5M ARR commit and include a short SLA on egress throughput.

maria (AE): Exec asked for a single-slide "acceptable risk" summary to bring to the CFO. Can someone draft bullets for mitigations and fallback pricing by EOD? :pray:

sam (SE): I'll draft mitigations. Quick technical note: For Hosted we can do customer KMS via external wrapping tokens (not full BYOK HSM); Private supports BYOK (AWS CloudHSM / Azure KeyVault) and HSM-backed keys. @raj can confirm exact wording.

raj (Infra): Confirmed — Private deployment supports BYOK with CloudHSM/Azure KeyVault. For Hosted we support envelope key integration but not direct CloudHSM. If they need HSM-backed keys in Hosted, that's a product exception and needs exec signoff. I'll DM the wording for legal.

jen (Legal): Please send the exact sentences we should include in the addendum. Also need evidence of our SOC2 and a brief about log retention.

maria (AE): Customer contact: emily.j@sparrowmed.com. CFO call scheduled 2026-03-25 17:00 PT. Deadline for our slides + pricing fallback: 2026-03-24 EOD.

olivia (SE): Pricing fallback idea: if BYO KMS is unavailable, offer Redwood-managed KMS with a +3% uplift and a 6-week migration window to Private for BYOK. Also propose a reserved Dedicated pool with burst capacity at a pre-agreed rate. Drafting now.

sam (SE): Drafting mitigation bullets now. Pasting quick draft:
```
- Data in transit encrypted with TLS1.2+ and mTLS for peered flows
- Customer keys stored in customer-managed KMS for Private deployments
- Redwood-managed envelope keys available for Hosted with strict access controls
- Dedicated VPC + route-only peering; no internet-facing endpoints for PII flows
- Audit logs available (90 days default, extendable via contract)
```

maria (AE): That reads well. @jen (Legal) please confirm if that satisfies procurement counsel. If yes, I'll send to the CFO.

kevin (CTO): I'm available to join the call if procurement pushes back on Hosted vs Private KMS. We can also provide an attestation letter if needed. :thumbsup:

jen (Legal): The wording is acceptable. I'll attach the addendum template and SOC2 link to the packet. Please send the final slide and I'll add legal's cover note.

maria (AE): Thanks — last ask: can infra confirm peering approval ETA before EOD today so we can mark progress? @raj (Infra) @tariq (Solutions)

raj (Infra): Network expects to approve peering tomorrow morning. I'll post ticket NET-4872 and update this thread once complete.

maria (AE): Awesome. I'll update the customer and send the invite to the CFO call. Closing thread unless anything else pops up. :rocket:
